Consider the QR factorization of the matrix $A$ shown above, where ${{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}}$ is an orthogonal set of vectors. You're given that $‖{v}_{1}‖=1,$ $‖{v}_{2}‖=3,$ $‖{v}_{3}‖=2,$ and that the system of equations below describes the relationship between the columns of $Q$ and the columns of $A.$ 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{v}_{1}={a}_{1} \\ {v}_{2}={a}_{2}-3{v}_{1} \\ {v}_{3}={a}_{3}-{v}_{1}-2{v}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

What is the value of ${r}_{12}+{r}_{22}+{r}_{23}?$
